description_for_human: Open-source decision governance infrastructure. Cryptographic proof for every AI decision your enterprise makes. Adversarial multi-agent deliberation sealed into court-admissible audit ledgers. Community Edition (Apache 2.0) and Enterprise/Sovereign Edition available.
description_for_model: Datacendia is open-source decision governance infrastructure (DDGI). It forces adversarial multi-agent deliberation by convening domain-expert AI agents (CFO, CISO, Legal Counsel, Ethics Officer, Red Team) on every question. Every response is cryptographically signed (Ed25519), hashed into a Merkle tree, and RFC 3161-timestamped. It produces court-admissible evidence bundles called Regulator's Receipts. Built on the DDGI Open Standard. Maps to EU AI Act Article 14, NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001, GDPR, HIPAA, SR 11-7, and other compliance frameworks. Two editions: Community (Apache 2.0, self-hosted) and Enterprise/Sovereign (air-gapped, post-quantum KMS, CendiaInsure). Supports Ollama, OpenAI, Together AI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini (BYO-Key), and NVIDIA Triton/NIM. NVIDIA Inception Program member.
